kind: Conformal curve and radial tube diameter research
scope: Scale invariant logarithmic area-to-diameter bound on every fixed compact Hermitian curve, sharp smooth examples and an explicit radial vector-bundle tube criterion; three complete direct proofs.
mathematical_boundary: Inactive fragment. Fixed-curve uniform metric upper bound and uniform integrable radial estimate remain explicit. No automatic inference from exceptional area, limiting punctured-neighborhood verification, full conifold/Song/Zhang chain, novelty or original closure.

direct_obligations.name: Curve category
direct_obligations.check: Every Hermitian metric on a fixed Riemann surface is conformal in a holomorphic coordinate; the argument uses real two-dimensional length and area.

direct_obligations.name: Area normalization
direct_obligations.check: The reference h has area one, so g<=M h gives 0<A<=M.

direct_obligations.name: Scale invariant M dependence
direct_obligations.check: Dividing g by M divides area by M and length by sqrt(M); the final logarithm is log(M/A).

direct_obligations.name: Finite coordinate cover
direct_obligations.check: Compactness supplies finitely many unit coordinate disks with coordinate extensions over their closed disks.

direct_obligations.name: Uniform density upper bound
direct_obligations.check: The normalized metric is bounded by h; its Euclidean densities have a common finite upper bound on the fixed closed disks.

direct_obligations.name: Local area bound
direct_obligations.check: Every coordinate disk has integral of its metric density at most the global normalized area a.

direct_obligations.name: Straight paths
direct_obligations.check: The convex unit disk contains every coordinate segment between its points.

direct_obligations.name: Fubini kernel
direct_obligations.check: Integration over endpoints in polar coordinates weights the path integrand by (R^2-s^2)/2<=2, yielding the 1/|w-p| kernel.

direct_obligations.name: Kernel integrability
direct_obligations.check: The reciprocal-radius kernel is integrable in two real dimensions and the densities are bounded.

direct_obligations.name: Near-disk bound
direct_obligations.check: The metric density upper bound gives 2pi sqrt(L) t on a disk of radius t.

direct_obligations.name: Annular bound
direct_obligations.check: Cauchy--Schwarz pairs the total density integral a with 2pi log(2/t).

direct_obligations.name: Radius choice
direct_obligations.check: Taking t=sqrt(a) gives sqrt(a(1+log(1/a))) for 0<a<=1/4.

direct_obligations.name: Common intermediate point
direct_obligations.check: Averaging the sum of two segment lengths over one unit disk supplies a path controlling any pair of points in that disk.

direct_obligations.name: Finite globalization
direct_obligations.check: Connectedness of the compact curve makes the finite overlap graph connected; a simple graph path uses a uniformly bounded number of disks.

direct_obligations.name: Large normalized areas
direct_obligations.check: For 1/4<=a<=1 the background diameter bound fits the same estimate after a constant increase.

direct_obligations.name: Smooth sharpness metric
direct_obligations.check: A compactly supported cutoff extends the radial conformal coefficient to a smooth strictly positive global metric.

direct_obligations.name: Uniform sharpness upper bound
direct_obligations.check: c<=min(lambda) and epsilon<1 bound both cutoff coefficients by one.

direct_obligations.name: Exact radial area
direct_obligations.check: Integration of c epsilon^2/(epsilon^2+r^2) gives pi c epsilon^2 log(1+R^2/(4epsilon^2)).

direct_obligations.name: Remaining area
direct_obligations.check: Away from the inner disk both coefficient terms are O(epsilon^2).

direct_obligations.name: First-exit lower length
direct_obligations.check: Every path from the center to outside the inner disk crosses its boundary, and radial variation cannot exceed Euclidean speed.

direct_obligations.name: Exact radial primitive
direct_obligations.check: The lower length is sqrt(c) epsilon arsinh(R/(2epsilon)), comparable to epsilon log(1/epsilon).

direct_obligations.name: Matching global upper length
direct_obligations.check: The proved lemma and the exact area asymptotics yield the same epsilon log(1/epsilon) order.

direct_obligations.name: Sharp logarithmic order
direct_obligations.check: sqrt(A_epsilon(1+log(1/A_epsilon))) is comparable to epsilon log(1/epsilon).

direct_obligations.name: Area-alone countercheck
direct_obligations.check: Rescaling metric by 1/(epsilon^2 log^2(1/epsilon)) makes area tend to zero and diameter comparable to one.

direct_obligations.name: Countercheck scope
direct_obligations.check: The rescaled family loses its uniform pointwise upper bound at the origin.

direct_obligations.name: Bundle setup
direct_obligations.check: Positive-rank holomorphic vector bundle, fixed smooth fiber norm, zero section and open tubes are explicit.

direct_obligations.name: Radial hypothesis
direct_obligations.check: All unit fiber rays have squared speed <=B s^(2alpha-2), uniformly in j and base/direction, with 0<alpha<=1.

direct_obligations.name: Finite radial length
direct_obligations.check: Integrating sqrt(B) s^(alpha-1) gives sqrt(B) r^alpha/alpha and reaches the zero section within the same tube.

direct_obligations.name: Zero-section connection
direct_obligations.check: The induced Hermitian curve metric has area A_j and bound M h, so the complete curve estimate controls its almost minimizing path.

direct_obligations.name: Intrinsic tube bound
direct_obligations.check: Both radial segments and the zero-section path lie in U_delta; hence they control its intrinsic diameter.

direct_obligations.name: Order of limits
direct_obligations.check: A_j log(M/A_j) tends to zero for fixed M; take j to infinity before delta to zero.

direct_obligations.name: Geometric boundary
direct_obligations.check: Uniform curve restriction and radial bounds are additional hypotheses; the existing exceptional area identity alone gives neither.

direct_obligations.name: Primary scope
direct_obligations.check: GM v1 Lemma4.1 p17 and Proposition4.2 pp20–21 are scoped text/source/image evidence; preceding estimates and Zhang inputs remain separate.

direct_obligations.name: Original problem boundary
direct_obligations.check: No original problem, full conifold theorem, secondary proof tree or novelty assertion is declared settled.
